findings.one_line: The construction invokes sign-condition sampling as producing real-algebraic witnesses, but the cited theorem samples in R⟨ε,δ⟩; add a proved/cited specialization-to-real-algebraic-witness step (or use a source that supplies it) before the terminating GapCert construction follows.

cited_checks.note: The supplied Pataki excerpt states minimal-face preservation, relative Slater after replacement, strong duality, and finite facial reduction to the minimal face; these match the cited substrate used here.

The supplied Theorem 13.11 samples components in R⟨ε,δ⟩^k, whereas the core claim omits that extension and the downstream proof treats the samples as real-algebraic witnesses; the quoted result alone does not establish that conversion.
The supplied Anderson Theorem 1 has the same convex symmetric set, symmetric unimodal integrand, ray scaling, and weak integral inequality as the core lemma.
